anomalies.description: At ~44.5s, a person in the background (near the glass entrance) suddenly drops/collapses to the floor without visible contact or support—consistent with being shot. Simultaneously, the man in the white shirt at the right desk flinches and ducks behind the counter, and the man in the light blue shirt also reacts abruptly by leaning down behind his desk. The woman in yellow turns sharply toward the incident and crouches. These coordinated, sudden evasive reactions without physical contact strongly indicate gunfire.
